en.html:
Hell?
Purgatory?
Or merely the human world in miniature?

The name would depend on the observer.
But the essence of this scene was pure and single. Whatever label was attached, it did not change.


People fought one another.
People killed one another.

People killed.
People died.

An ending.
A catastrophe.

en.html:
Amid ruin, blessing ruin.
Anticipating more, wishing for more, Chachamaru sings.

Like the devout priest of a remote tribe worshipping a god of destruction.
Like an old bishop in a great city's church offering scripture to his one God with despair and hatred.

Chachamaru Ashikaga affirmed this catastrophe.
Boasted that her one soul desired and accepted these countless deaths.

Her appearance was crimson flame itself.
A red, darkly burning Dusk Flare.

—If a devil existed,
it was probably standing before me now.

ja.html:
滅びの中で、滅びを<ruby>言祝<rt>ことほ</rt></ruby>ぎ。
　更なる滅びの到来を予期し、願って、茶々丸が<ruby>詩<rt>うた</rt></ruby>う。

　未開の地の敬虔な蛮族の<ruby>巫<rt>かんなぎ</rt></ruby>が破壊の神を祀るように。
　大都市の教会で年老いた司教が絶望と憎悪を込めて
唯一神への聖句を捧げるように。

　足利茶々丸は、この破局を肯定する。
　己の一個の魂がこの無数の死を欲し受け入れるのだ
と豪語する。

　その<ruby>形容<rt>かたち</rt></ruby>はまさに紅蓮。
　赤く昏く燃え盛る<ruby>夕闇の陽炎<rt>ダスクフレア</rt></ruby>。

　――悪魔が実在するとすれば。
　それは今、俺の前に立っているのだろう。

Chachamaru and I watched the ending.

The silver meteor swarm swept across heaven, exterminating the other stars—the shogunate and occupation warriors.
Seen from the ground, that most gruesome struggle was a beautiful twilight ball of stars.

One star shone lovelier than the rest: the swiftest, fiercest.

ja.html:
俺と茶々丸は終わりを見守る。

　白銀の流星群は天界を席巻し、もはや他の星を――
幕府や進駐軍の武者を――殲滅しつつある。
　凄惨極まる闘争劇は、地上から眺める限り、世にも
美しい黄昏の星々の舞踏会だった。

　そこに際立って麗しく輝くのは、最も速く猛き一星。

Chachamaru"Limit of Power…"
Chachamaru"The other power will arrive soon too."
Kageaki"And then—"
Chachamaru"The wall separating God from the surface… We'll break through a hundred and fifteen kilometres of crust."
Chachamaru"God comes."
Kageaki"…………"
Chachamaru"…Something wrong, bhai?"
Kageaki"No."
Kageaki"We summon this god for our own purposes. But what will that god have in mind when it comes to the surface…?"
Kageaki"I was thinking about that."
Chachamaru"…Who knows. Who can say."
Chachamaru"Maybe the classic arrangement."
Chachamaru"Maybe to atone for the sins of all humanity."
